description: This PHP class RequestParams is part of the OrangeHRM system. It handles extracting and validating request parameters (body, attributes, query) including various data types, attachments, and date/time values for API version 2. It includes sanitization logic for SVG images and utility methods for parameter access.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: A class managing extraction and validation of request parameters (body, attributes, query) including support for various data types, attachments with sanitization, and date/time parsing, used in API v2 of OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from specified parameter bag, with default fallback.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter that can be null, with optional empty string conversion.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter, throws exception if empty string provided.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter that can be null.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter that can be null.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter that can be null.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an array parameter that can be null.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment object, ensuring validation and sanitization.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment object that can be null, sanitizing SVG images.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Parses a date/time parameter, applying timezone if provided.

methods.name: getDateTimeOrNull
methods.description: Parses a date/time parameter that can be null.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the specified parameter bag.
